facts.text: Deborah's father passed away two days before the session date of 27 January 2023.

evidence.quote: my dad passed away two days ago

facts.text: Deborah and her family are spending more time together to cope with the loss of her father.

evidence.quote: I'm trying to channel my grief by spending more time with family and cherishing the memories

facts.text: Deborah and her family looked at a family album that includes a photo of her parents' wedding in 1993.

evidence.quote: We looked at the family album. Photos give me peace during difficult times. This is my parents' wedding in 1993.

facts.text: Deborah and her husband are trying to emulate the qualities of her parents' relationship.

evidence.quote: My husband and I are trying to be as good a family as my parents were!
